AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89802843478
Zoom Meeting ID: 898 0284 3478
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 898 0284 3478#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please use the "raise your hand feature" or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.

Consideration of a Request from the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation to Amend their Concession Agreement and Offer Fifty (50) Additional Pickleball Only Memberships (For A Total Of 100 Such Memberships)
Recommendation: (1) Consider a request from the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation (PVTF) to amend their Concession Agreement and offer fifty (50) additional pickle ball only memberships for a total of 100 such memberships, amend the ratio of resident to non-resident members to 60/40 and increase the initiation fees to $350 resident/$450 non-resident; and (2) direct the City Manager and City Attorney as deemed appropriate.

Adoption of Resolution No. R21-03: the Transfer of Residual or Un-Restricted Resources from (1) the Palos Verdes Law Enforcement Fund, (2) the Capital Improvements Fund, (3) the Sewer Fund, and (4) Adopt Guidelines Related to the Budget Preparation and Financial Management of Capital and Capital-Like Projects
Recommendation: Adopt proposed resolution No. R21-03 approving the transfer of unrestricted resources from (1) the Palos Verdes Law Enforcement Fund, (2) the Sewer Fund, and (3) the Capital Improvements Fund, and (4) adopt guidelines related to the budget preparation and financial management of capital and capital-like projects.
Staff Report

  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom
pursuant to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020,
was called to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:30 P.M. on January 13, 2021 , notice having been
given with affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following
information to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89802843478
  Zoom Meeting ID: 898 0284 3478
  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code: 898 0284 3478#

  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are
available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-01

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 021-748

CALL TO ORDER 6:30 P.M.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
  Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Acting
  Police Chief Best, Acting Planning & Building Director Rindge, Finance Director
  Hannah, City Clerk Chaney

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember
  Roos to approve the agenda.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Councilmember

  NOES:  None

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
JANUARY 13, 2021
 1.  City Council Action Minutes

  a.  December 22, 2020 Special Closed Session Meeting Minutes
  b.  December 22, 2020 Special Meeting Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved.

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers

  Reviewed and Approved Warrant Registers: 01132021-A, 01132021-B, 01132021-
  C, 01132021-D, 01132021-E, 01132021-F, 01132021-G, 01132021 -H, 12242020-A,
  01082021-A

3.  Approval and Certification of the Palos Verdes Estates Sanitary Sewer
  Management Plan 5-Year Update

  Approved and certified the updated City of Palos Verdes Estates Sanitary Sewer
  Management Plan (SSMP) and authorized the City Manager to execute the
  certification of the SSMP on behalf of the City and submit the certification to the
  State Water Resources Control Board.

4.  Adoption  of Resolution  R21-01  (1) Making  a  Supplemental
  Appropriation from the Supplemental Law Enforcement  Services  Fund
  (SLESF)/Citizen's Option for Public Safety (Cops) Fund in the Amount of
  $7,720.00 And (2) Authorizing the City Support Services Director to Make
  Such  Accounting Entries for this Supplemental Appropriation as
  Deemed Appropriate.

  Adopted Resolution R21-01: (1) making a supplemental appropriation from the
  Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund (SLESF)/Citizen' s Option for Public
  Safety (COPS) Fund in the amount of $7,270.00 and (2) authorizing the City Support
  Services Director to make such accounting entries for this supplemental
  appropriation as deemed appropriate

5.  Adoption of Resolution R21-02 Approving a Supplemental Appropriation in the
  Amount of $181,500.00 from the Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation
  (RMRA) Fund for PW-680-20 FY 19/20 Miscellaneous Street Repairs Project

  Recommendation: Adopted proposed Resolution R2 l -02:  ( 1) approving a
  supplemental appropriation in the amount of$181,500.00 from the Road Maintenance
  and Rehabilitation (RMRA) Fund for Fiscal Year 2020/2021; and (2) authorizing the
  City Support Services Director to make all related accounting entries necessary to
  record this action of the City Council.

 6.  Update to Committee Liaison Assignments

  Approved the updated Committee Liaisons.

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
Mayor Kemps noted that the Police Ad Hoc presentation will take place on January 30, 2021.
He also announced that the Council selected Janine Nendick and Leslie DeHoff to fill the
unexpired terms on the Planning Commission and Finance Advisory Committee, and provided
updates from Cox Communications.

 Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

 CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
 City Manager Guglielmo announced that the Housing and Safety Element Public Kick-off
 Meeting will take place on January 27, 2021. She thanked the Police Department staff, the
 Urban Forester and the Code Enforcement officer for their service while the Streets and Parks
 Department was out.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 JANUARY 13, 2021
 Acting Chief Best reported staffing updates in the Police Department, including the hiring of
Charles Gill, the promotion of Aaron Belda, and the retirement of Tony Gonzalez. He also noted
the Neptune Award to Erick Gaunt.

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Merlin David addressed the City Council.

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

PUBLIC HEARING(S)

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

7.  Overview of Assembly Bill 571, Which Sets Default Candidate Contribution
  Limits for City and County Offices

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to receive and file the report on AB 571 , with the option to draft an
  ordinance related to candidate contributions in the future .

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

8.  Approval of the Palos Verdes Tennis Club's 2021 Proposed Operating Budget,
  Capital Fund Budget and 10-Year Capital Investment Fund Forecast and
  Approval of New and Revised Dues for 2021.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  Mayor Kemps and Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi recused themselves from this item due to
  being members of the Tennis Club.

  Ian Forsyth and Kim Bridge reported on behalf of the Tennis Club.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Councilmember Murdock
  to approve the Tennis Club budget as presented, with the modification that the
  Tennis Club consult with the Liaisons in advance for any capital expenditure in
  excess of $20,000, and that they remain active in the established taskforce.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan
  NOES:  None

9.  Consideration of a Request from the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation to Amend
  their Concession Agreement and Offer Fifty (50) Additional Pickle ball Only
  Memberships (For A Total Of 100 Such Memberships)

  Mayor Kemps and Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi recused themselves from this item due to
  being members of the Tennis Club.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Councilmember Roos
  to approve an additional twenty resident pickle ball memberships at the $350
  initiation fee, with the instruction that the Tennis Club work with the Liaisons
  regarding future expansion which would address parking, long-range planning and
  the fee structure.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 JANUARY 13, 2021
   AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan
  NOES:  None

10.  Adoption of Resolution No. R21-03: the Transfer of Residual or Un-Restricted
  Resources from (1) the Palos Verdes Law Enforcement Fund, (2) the Capital
  Improvements Fund, (3) the Sewer Fund, and (4) Adopt Guidelines Related to
  the Budget Preparation and Financial Management of Capital and Capital-Like
  Projects

  Joan Davidson addressed the City Council.

  Recommendation: Adopt proposed resolution No. R21-03 approving the transfer of
  unrestricted resources from (1) the Palos Verdes Law Enforcement Fund, (2) the
  Sewer Fund, and (3) the Capital Improvements Fund, and (4) adopt guidelines related
  to the budget preparation and financial management of capital and capital-like
  projects.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to adopt resolution R21-03 , with the amendment that the section three
  funds include a sub category assigned to Sewer Capital projects.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

 MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

 Councilmember Murdock noted that she attended the Livable California Zoom Meeting, which
 discussed SB9 and SB 10, and local control initiatives. She also attended South Bay Cities
 Council of Governments meetings, which discussed local control in zoning and public health.

 Councilmember Roos also attended the Council of Governments meeting regarding public
 health. He noted that the public can go to vaccinatelacounty.com to get information on how to
 receive the Covid vaccine.

 Councilmember McGowan will be attending the Sanitation Districts meeting and will be re-
 activating the task force with the golf and tennis clubs.

 Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi requested future agenda items for an update on the traffic study, George
 Allen Field, parking, and a review of HR Greens Capital Projects Report.

 Mayor Kemps indicated he did not have anything more to add.

 ADJOURNMENT

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, Seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to adjourn the meeting at 10:17 p.m.

  AYES:  Roos , Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

 RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 JANUARY 13, 2021
